items.title: Install Echelon Foundry SDE 1.2.0
items.description: Adds .sde/ reference material and .echelon/sde.json via npx @echelon-foundry/sde init

items.title: Upgrade ROS installation from 1.2.1 to 3.0.3
items.description: Adopts the 3.x governance documents and the ros-fs launcher. The ten scaffold files that blocked the upgrade had no local edits (single commit each, the original 1.2.1 install), so the 3.x versions replace them without losing work. Also sets ros.json rosVersion to 3.0.3, which ros upgrade does not do itself.

items.title: Give the documentation-contract CLI test a timeout proportional to its 13 subprocess spawns
items.description: The test measured 4.3s idle against vitest's 5s default and failed on a loaded CI runner. Not a flake: it spawns 13 processes, five of which start the self-contained .NET binary.
